info.title: Agri-Stack 360 mobile API (Farmer + DA)
info.description: Generated from the platform code by scripts/export_mobile_kit.py. Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> from POST /api/auth/login.

get.description: All crops (with date ranges), regions, varieties, markets. Cached.
Return varieties for the given crop (for cascading dropdown).
Return markets for the given region (for cascading dropdown).

Return filtered, server-aggregated weekly price data per market.
Auto-aggregates to weekly averages when result set would exceed MAX_POINTS per market.

Return aggregated stats for the current filter set:
latest price, week-over-week %, 4-week avg, supply signal.
Demo deployment only (DEMO_MODE=1): one-tap demo sign-ins for the sign-in page. Never the admin.

Current user and permissions. The frontend calls this on load, so role
changes made by an admin show up without signing out.

put.description: The signed-in person changes their own consent; nobody else can do it here.

get.description: Everything stored about the signed-in person (data-subject access, Proclamation 1321/2024).

post.description: Ask for all my data to be deleted; an administrator reviews the request.

get.description: Own farms for farmers, farms in their region for agents, every farm for admins.
Regions (no parent), zones of a region, or woredas of a zone.
An area with its full lineage (region > zone > woreda).
Find areas by name, e.g. 'Dewa' -> Dewa Cheffa, Dewa Harewa.

Crop calendar for each active season: current stage and tasks, next stage, the full timeline.
Stage day ranges are estimates from the MoA manuals (timing_estimated).

post.description:
Photo + the farm's altitude and past-week weather -> disease model -> decision -> plan.

capture_source: "camera" or "gallery" (sent by the app). With the farmer's training consent the
photo is also added to the training dataset (backend/training_data.py).
Spec §9: a diagnosis produced elsewhere (e.g. an on-device model) -> treatment plan.
WAV audio of the text: Gemini TTS (am/ti/en) or the local MMS voice (om, and fallback).
Spoken question -> text for the farmer to check and send. The audio is not stored.

The answer reaches the farmer as an in-app alert: a reply to their own question, so it is
delivered even without alert consent (that consent covers unrequested alerts and reminders).
Pass a case the DA cannot answer to an agronomist (the review queue), or an administrator if there is none.

Confirm or correct what the photo check found. Outbreak counting uses the corrected disease,
and the record is kept for retraining the model.

get.description: Choices for the verify control, in the DA's language.

Shops with the verified-seller badge (and, if asked, the product in stock), nearest areas first:
same woreda, then same zone, then same region, then elsewhere.

post.description: Accepting shares my plots, crop seasons and contributions with this ABC's managers. Leaving stops it.

farmer_id.title: Farmer Id
farmer_id.description: Ask on behalf of this farmer (DA / admin). Defaults to yourself.

disease.title: Disease
disease.description: Model class label (e.g. 'Yellow Rust') or disease key ('yellow_rust')

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: Temporary password the farmer changes later

disease_key.title: Disease Key
disease_key.description: A key from the diseases table, including 'healthy'

diagnosis_id.title: Diagnosis Id
diagnosis_id.description: Photo check this pack is for: the answer then says whether the product is on that treatment plan.
